Hi Asha — thanks for the docs and for including Priya. Quick confirmation of Redwood's process so there are no surprises on the PO/invoice side: 

1) DocuSign & onboarding portal
- You'll receive a DocuSign envelope shortly for our supplier terms and vendor setup authorization. Please sign the DocuSign (PowerForm) so finance can verify the legal acceptance. DocuSign link: https://na3.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

2) Withholding policy and PO signage
- Redwood will:
  - Create a PoS (Purchase Order) referencing the net service amount.
  - Apply withholding in accordance with Indian law if the tax team determines it's required after reviewing your submitted tax residency certificate and any treaty claims.
  - If withholding applies, Redwood will remit the withheld tax to the Indian authorities and provide the relevant withholding certificate (TDS certificate) where available.

3) Invoice requirements (please confirm):
- Invoices must include: invoice number, invoice date, service description, gross amount, GST separately listed with GSTIN, and your bank details.
- If you want Redwood to pay gross and for CloudMojo to self-report, we need an explicit statement and legal basis (we will escalate to tax counsel).

4) PO timing
- Once DocuSign is signed and the portal record is complete, finance expects to raise the PO within 3 business days. Payment terms as discussed (Net 30 from invoice receipt) unless otherwise negotiated.

If that's acceptable, please sign the DocuSign and upload the signed residency cert into the portal. Happy to jump on a short call if any of the tax items need further detail.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Procurement Analyst
Redwood Inference
